# Feature Template

## Summary

Short description of the feature and the specific capability it adds.

## User / agent story

Describe who uses the feature and what they need to do.

## Acceptance criteria

Write testable criteria that define when the feature is complete.

## Scope

### In scope

List the implementation boundaries.

### Out of scope

List explicit non-goals.

## Data / API impact

Describe schema changes, API routes, server actions, or integration effects.

## UX notes

Capture layout, interaction, validation, and behavior details relevant to implementation.

## Dependencies

List features, epics, or technical prerequisites.

## Related docs

Link to the parent epic and any architecture or product docs.

## Open questions

Record unresolved decisions that must be answered before or during implementation.
